problem.context: Multi-account, multi-region AWS environments with fragmented, script-based backup and DR practices.
pain_points: Backups exist but are not centrally orchestrated or validated.
No single source of truth for what can actually be restored after a severe incident.
DR exercises are rare, manual, and stressful.
Audit evidence for backup and recovery posture is hard and slow to assemble.
do_nothing_risks: Extended downtime during real incidents due to unclear recovery procedure.
Regulatory or contractual non-compliance related to RTO/RPO and DR testing.
Loss of trust from stakeholders when recovery posture is exposed as weak.
Silent backup gaps that only surface during crisis.

key_needs: Automate backup and DR operations across regions and accounts.
Reduce reliance on fragile one-off scripts.
Execute DR drills and real incidents with confidence.
Quickly understand which workloads are protected and how.
Prove that backup and recovery policies are implemented and tested.
Access clear, exportable evidence for audits.
Detect gaps before regulators or customers do.

jobs_to_be_done.statement: When I am responsible for AWS backup and DR, I want a single orchestrated process that covers all critical workloads, so I can be confident we can recover from a region-level incident.
When planning or running a DR drill, I want a clear, scripted recovery path based on current backup artifacts, so I can execute the exercise without guesswork or surprises.
When preparing for an audit, I want to generate a concise report of backup and recovery coverage, so I can demonstrate compliance without manual data collection.

value_proposition.statement: For teams responsible for AWS resilience and compliance, IaaC Recovery Suite is a recovery orchestration and audit tool that turns fragmented backups into a provable, repeatable disaster-recovery capability.
differentiators: End-to-end view from backup orchestration to recovery audit and evidence.
Focus on region/account loss scenarios, not only single-resource restores.
Structured manifests and reports designed for auditors and engineers alike.
SymK-friendly architecture that enables AI-assisted analysis and reporting.

business: Reduce time to assemble audit-ready evidence for backup/DR from weeks to days or hours.
Increase percentage of critical workloads covered by orchestrated, validated backups to >= 95%.
Increase number of successful DR drills per year without increasing human effort.
user: Cloud/SRE teams report increased confidence in DR posture in internal surveys.
Number of severe incidents where backups are unusable or incomplete trends to zero.
technical: Backup and audit runs complete within defined windows for target account/region sizes.
Tooling can handle at least N accounts and M regions without manual tuning.
All critical operations are fully logged and traceable.
constraints: Must respect AWS IAM least-privilege and organizational SCPs.
Must not materially increase blast radius or risk of misconfiguration.
Must integrate with existing logging and observability standards.

in: AWS-based workloads running in EC2 and related services.
EBS snapshot orchestration, AMI creation, and S3 backup manifests.
Discovery and audit of backup artifacts for completeness and consistency.
Facilitation of DR drills and recovery rehearsals.
out: Real-time transactional replication (e.g., database-level replication engines).
Acting as a full cloud management platform beyond backup/DR scope.
assumptions: Organization already uses AWS as a primary or critical cloud provider.
Basic AWS backup capabilities (EBS snapshots, S3, AMIs) are available.
Teams are willing to standardize around a single orchestrator for backup/DR.

feature_themes.name: Backup Orchestration and Manifests
feature_themes.description: Orchestrate EBS snapshots, AMIs, and S3 backups across accounts/regions with per-run manifests.

feature_themes.name: Recovery Audit and Gap Detection
feature_themes.description: Inspect backup repositories and detect missing, stale, or inconsistent artifacts with clear remediation hints.

feature_themes.name: DR Simulation and Rehearsals
feature_themes.description: Provide playbooks and tooling to stand up recovery environments for DR drills using existing artifacts.

feature_themes.name: Compliance Evidence and Reporting
feature_themes.description: Generate audit-ready reports and evidence packages from manifests and run history.
